title: Executive Manager
description:
Overview: **Serve as the overall UI technical lead for AIQ, driving the design, architecture, and delivery of user experience capabilities across the platform.****Lead execution of critical UI initiatives supporting AIQ roadmap commitments and business deliverables planned for 2026\.****Ensure scalable, consistent, and high\-quality user experiences across AIQ applications, enabling successful delivery of global program objectives.**  


Responsibilities:  

* Build scalable user interface (UI) architecture and reusable components for web applications.
* Direct and support front\-end developers. Share best practices for coding and testing.
* Perform design and code reviews to improve performance, quality, and accessibility.
* Work with product managers, UX designers, and backend teams to turn requirements into working software.
* Establish guidelines for coding, tools, and UI patterns

  


Qualifications:  

* Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
* Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks like React, Angular
* Familiarity with design and prototyping tools like Figma
* 10\+ years in software or frontend development, with past lead experience.
* Clear communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving
